year is constant at 2013 (distinct_count 1, min=max=2013.0) and, together with month, day, and hour, decomposes the same instant already captured by time_hour (distinct_count 4341); operator context asks for one calendar DATE/TIMESTAMP column rather than three integer parts, so this raw part is dropped in favor of observation_timestamp_utc.

month has only 6 distinct values (1.0-6.0, null_rate 0.0) spanning the January-June 2013 extract window and is redundant with the richer time_hour field (distinct_count 4341); dropped per the operator's preference for a single date/time column over decomposed integer parts.

day ranges 1.0-31.0 with distinct_count 31 and null_rate 0.0 but is a redundant component of the same instant already encoded in time_hour (distinct_count 4341); dropped so the silver table carries one timestamp rather than three integer date parts.

hour ranges 0.0-23.0 (distinct_count 24, null_rate 0.0) and records local standard time, which is superseded for grain and ordering purposes by the UTC instant in time_hour; dropped to avoid carrying duplicate date/time parts, with the local-vs-UTC distinction noted in limitations.

decisions.rationale: year, month, day, and hour all decompose the same instant already encoded in time_hour (distinct_count 4341, null_rate 0.0), and operator context states the team carries a calendar date as one DATE/TIMESTAMP column rather than three integer parts, so the four raw parts are dropped in favor of observation_timestamp_utc.

_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta are all flagged is_airbyte_metadata: true in the profile and carry no business content (e.g. _airbyte_meta is "{}" for all 13014 rows), so all three are dropped.

wind_gust_mph has null_rate 0.745505 (9702 of 13014 rows), making it sparsely populated; it is retained as nullable rather than dropped since gusts are physically only recorded during gusty wind events.
duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across row_count 13014, so no exact duplicate rows exist in bronze and no dedupe logic is applied.

origin has distinct_count 3 and observation_timestamp_utc (from time_hour) has distinct_count 4341; their product (approximately 13023) is close to row_count 13014, indicating the grain is approximately one row per station per UTC hour.

purpose: This table provides cleaned hourly historical weather observations (temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, and visibility) for the three NYC airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) covering the January-June 2013 extract window, intended to feed downstream analyses that join weather conditions to NYC flight records.
usage: Join on origin and observation_timestamp_utc to the corresponding flights-side origin and scheduled hour; consumers must explicitly handle nulls in wind_direction_degrees, wind_speed_mph, wind_gust_mph, and pressure_millibars since these are legitimately missing for some hours rather than imputed, with wind_gust_mph missing most of the time (74.6% of rows).
limitations: The original local year, month, day, and hour integer parts were dropped in favor of the single UTC observation_timestamp_utc field, so local civil time before UTC conversion is not retained in this table. wind_gust_mph is null for 74.6% of rows (9702/13014) and pressure_millibars is null for 11.5% of rows (1496/13014), so aggregates over these columns must account for sparse coverage; no duplicate rows were found in bronze (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no deduplication was necessary.
